requirements.evidence: All contract items are present: entities schema with named slug unique and soft deletes (database/migrations/2026_10_29_032929_create_entities_table.php:14-20); memberships FKs, role default, generated owner_seq and both named unique indexes (database/migrations/2026_10_29_032930_create_entity_memberships_table.php:16-23); all policy abilities (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:11-38, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:11-38); transaction + hardcoded owner + collision retry + uniqueSlug (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:32-84); home dispatch, onboarding, switcher, pick and dashboard with auth+verified (routes/web.php:22-70); switcher markup/current state (resources/views/entity-switcher.blade.php:1-12); navbar >1 membership link (resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php:14-15); lang keys and docs/database-schema.md updated.

conventions.evidence: Good use of #[Fillable] (app/Models/Entity.php:13), #[Validate] (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:21), reversible migrations with down(), Blade components and the default-page layout. But entity creation is written inline in the Livewire component instead of an app/Actions/* class (CreateEntity.php:32-49), entity.pick authorizes by hand in a route closure instead of a policy/gate (routes/web.php:50-56), and no CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry is included despite conventions.md 'Keep docs in sync'.

security.evidence: submit() validates but never calls $this->authorize('create', Entity::class) even though EntityPolicy::create exists (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:24-26); current_entity is aliased at bootstrap/app.php:19-21 but not registered with Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware(), so it stops applying on Livewire update requests; Dashboard authorizes only in mount (app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:15-19). No unescaped output or unvalidated input was found; all views use {{ }} (entity-switcher.blade.php:8, livewire/entity/dashboard.blade.php:2).

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ files at all: no feature tests for the migrations, policies, middleware or routes, no happy-path test for CreateEntity/Dashboard, and no unauthorized-call or tamper tests, although conventions.md requires each of these for every Livewire action.

simplicity.evidence: The 0/1/>1 membership dispatch is duplicated between routes/web.php:22-40 and app/Http/Middleware/CurrentEntity.php:24-35; the layout is declared twice (CreateEntity.php:18 and :90); the same Entity is bound to two unused container keys (CurrentEntity.php:54-55); four unused/duplicate onboarding lang keys were added per locale (lang/en/ui.php:52-58).

readability.evidence: Models and policies are small, typed and documented (app/Models/EntityMembership.php:23-71, app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:11-38); submit() (CreateEntity.php:32-57) is understandable but mixes transaction, retry and logging, and the duplicate layout/lang declarations add avoidable noise.

scope.evidence: Core files all serve the task, but the diff also adds .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml (empty) and .github/workflows/tests.yml:1-11 (new CI unrelated to the task), plus unused lang keys.

issues.explanation: The change ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests at all, so none of the migrations, policies, middleware, routes or Livewire components are covered, and the required unauthorized-call and tamper tests are absent.

submit() validates the name but never calls $this->authorize('create', Entity::class), leaving the new create policy unused and violating the mandatory server-side authorization rule for Livewire actions.

The custom current_entity middleware is only aliased; it is never passed to Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware(), so it silently stops applying on Livewire update requests after the initial dashboard render.

Entity creation, owner membership creation and collision retry are implemented inline in the Livewire component rather than in an app/Actions/* use case, which conventions.md requires for domain writes.
The public Entity property is not #[Locked] and authorization runs only in mount(), so later Livewire requests are not re-authorized; impact is limited today because the component has no actions.
entity.pick performs a hand-written membership check and the session/audit write inside a route closure instead of using a policy/gate and an Action as the project conventions direct.
Only docs/database-schema.md was updated; conventions.md also requires an [Unreleased] CHANGELOG entry (and business-rules updates if the owner invariant is documented there).
Four duplicate/unused onboarding keys are added in each locale (onboarding_title/heading, entity_create_title/heading) on top of the create_entity_title/heading keys the component actually uses.
An empty deploy-dev.yml is unrelated to the task and looks like an accidental artifact.
This new CI workflow is unrelated to the task and cannot succeed because it does not set up PHP, install Composer dependencies or configure the app before running ./bin/pf shell php artisan test.
The layout is declared both with the #[Layout] attribute and again in render()->layout(); one declaration is enough.
The same Entity is bound to the container under two undocumented keys (current.entity and current_entity), and neither is consumed anywhere in the diff.
The 0/1/>1 membership dispatch logic is duplicated between /home and CurrentEntity, so the two implementations can drift apart.

review.summary: The change implements the entity/membership schema, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding, switcher, dashboard, routes, lang strings and schema docs, and the main flows are coherent. It cannot be approved as is because it ships no tests, skips mandatory Livewire authorization and persistent-middleware rules, bypasses the Actions convention for entity creation, and includes unrelated CI files.
